_about: Continuity cards for main-story: how each character starts each story day. A story day is a day inside the story, not a day of work. The shot sheet (shot-sheet.json) carries these forward shot by shot; a change is written there, with its reason. Names are never written here: cards are keyed by registry id, and props are listed by id.
